classification: Live read-only AWS CLI audit; account IDs, ARNs, bucket names, role names, and principals redacted

scope.s3: Default encryption and all four Block Public Access controls for the Data Exports and Athena-results buckets
scope.athena: The primary workgroup enforcement and query-result encryption settings
scope.quicksight_datasource_role: Trust services, policy inventory, and targeted scan for three workload-changing actions
scope.quicksight_assets: Explicit permission entries for deployed dashboards and the FinOps Q&A Topic

limitations: The permission scan is a resource-level review of explicit QuickSight permissions; it is not an exhaustive review of every account-level sharing, embedding, IAM, or organization control.
The IAM policy scan is targeted to the three listed workload-changing actions and is not a blanket certification of every IAM action.
Business owners, approval dates, and the formal access-review record require organisational assignment and are not inferred from AWS identities.
